items.text: Name the user or system decision that will consume the prediction.
Verify representative inputs and outcomes exist for the production population.
Measure a rule-based, manual, or current-system baseline before selecting a model.
Quantify the product cost of false positives, false negatives, abstentions, and delays.
Set an ML threshold and a business outcome that would justify deployment.
Define fallback behavior when the model is unavailable or uncertain.
Route high-cost or ambiguous decisions to an appropriate human review path.
Record exposure and selection effects that could bias future labels.
Confirm feature collection, retention, and model use satisfy privacy and access constraints.
Assign owners for monitoring, incidents, retraining, and model retirement.
